Description: Playwright launch failed when using default chromium headless path
Root Cause: Playwright browser binaries had not been cached at ~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell
Resolution Implemented: Configured executablePath: '/usr/bin/google-chrome' using the system installed Google Chrome

Description: Uncapped devicePixelRatio on 3x mobile screens caused potential fill rate bottleneck
Root Cause: Window devicePixelRatio was passed directly to canvas without ceiling
Resolution Implemented: Implemented Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1 2) to cap retina rendering at 2x

Description: esbuild CSS syntax warning in stdin: Expected identifier but found '-'
Root Cause: Upstream legacy class name or vendor prefix from Tailwind build
Resolution Implemented: Resolved via index.css standard CSS keyframes with strict W3C naming

Description: Background canvas particle loop continued running when tab was minimized or backgrounded
Root Cause: requestAnimationFrame was executing unconditionally regardless of tab state
Resolution Implemented: Added document.addEventListener('visibilitychange') to freeze physics on hidden tabs

Description: Need strict compliance with system prefers-reduced-motion
Root Cause: Users with vestibular disorders must not receive moving particles
Resolution Implemented: Added window.matchMedia listener + instant canvas clear and RAF pause when active

Description: Potential for sound effects to violate enterprise zero-audio constraint
Root Cause: Ambiguous specifications could accidentally include sound tags or roars
Resolution Implemented: Enforced strict zero-audio design pattern with zero audio APIs or sound assets
